tools.name: get_guidelines
tools.description: Read this first. How to install, fill and fit Lexington sections into an Astro + Tailwind project, and what not to change.

tools.name: list_themes
tools.description: Every theme available, with who it is for, its visual personality, fonts, light/dark mode and section count. Pick one theme per page.

tools.name: search_sections
tools.description: Find sections by role and description. Returns id, group and a one-line description. Use the ids with get_sections.

tools.name: get_theme_setup
tools.description: Once per project, per theme: tokens.css and Fonts.astro to write, plus the two setup steps. Call before the first get_sections for a theme.

tools.name: get_design
tools.description: The theme's design system: typography recipes, what each colour scale means, spacing rhythm, components, do and don't, plus roles.json (the same as data: action, panel, ink, muted, rule, radius, heading and body recipes, measured from the sections).
